capabilities: Opens Atlas VTT maps on a 3D board with tokens, minis, walls, doors and lights
Imports 3D minis from GLB, HeroForge and TaleSpire files into a gallery
Simulates physics dice rolls and logs results to Atlas's roll log
Runs initiative tracking, token groups and turn indicators during fights
Stacks scenes as elevation layers with line of sight, materials and lighting
disambiguation: Not a standalone virtual tabletop; it renders Atlas VTT maps in 3D and depends on Atlas VTT for maps, tokens, initiative and rules.
extras: GLB minis must be self-contained and uncompressed (no Draco or Meshopt); some lighting and displacement features cost frame rate on slow graphics cards, and the README notes users should check HeroForge and creator terms before sharing minis.
intentEvidence: Tabletop for Atlas VTT is a community extension.
problem: Atlas VTT maps are flat 2D images, so GMs who want a three-dimensional tabletop view of the same maps, walls and tokens have no way to get one inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Opens Atlas VTT maps on a 3D board in Obsidian.
Players joined through Connect for Atlas VTT or Atlas Online see the minis too
The dice's shapes, faces and pack format come from Interactive Dice for Atlas VTT (MIT).
a TaleSpire creature (root.tsMod, or the zip from mod.io)
a HeroForge Unity3D export (the .unity3d file, or the zip HeroForge gives you)

summary: 3D board view for Atlas VTT maps with tokens, 3D minis, walls, doors, lights, dice and initiative tracking inside Obsidian.
